Problem Statement:
A ticket booking system needs a program to calculate ticket pricing based on age and time of booking. 
Write a C program to calculate the ticket price. 
If the customer is below 12 years, the price is ₹50.
If the customer is above 60 years, the price is ₹70.
For all others, the price is ₹100.
If the booking is made during an early bird window (before 10 AM), apply a 20% discount. 
Sample Input:
10, 9 
Sample Output:
Ticket Price: ₹50.00
